evidence: The full body queries context selector 0x13, sets the forwarded third argument to zero when the returned byte equals 4 (otherwise preserves the incoming c->x[2]), loads the global pointer at 0x7003a89728, and tail-calls f_700182d170. That helper walks a compacted list and dispatches per-entry work, but the precise operation/domain remains unclear. Its caller invokes it in a larger context update. Leave unnamed. decompiled/main/main_0055.c:13769-13790; helper decompiled/main/main_0169.c:50953-50997; caller decompiled/main/main_0085.c:29541-29545.

Queries selectors 5 and 0x45. If selector 0x45 is zero it returns 0x46; otherwise it returns selector 5 unchanged when input low-bit flag is clear, or selector 5 minus 10 when that flag is set. The caller derives the flag from a preceding selector comparison and uses the result in a later threshold check. decompiled/main/main_0057.c:52167-52190; caller decompiled/main/main_0182.c:50942-50954.

Stores the global pointer loaded from 0x70022a6ce0 plus 0x10 into the supplied record at offset 0, calls three setup helpers, then tail-calls f_7000dcfc9c with the record. Its direct caller invokes this as a setup step before returning through another helper; broader resource/domain meaning is not established. decompiled/main/main_0172.c:11278-11296; caller decompiled/main/main_0172.c:11305-11313.

Queries accepted context selector 8 with attribute_context_status_value_get and returns 1 exactly when the result is nonzero, otherwise 0. Its caller consumes the result in an attribute-context flow. decompiled/main/main_0006.c:34341-34353; caller decompiled/main/main_0014.c:31474-31480.

Queries context selector 9, passes the result to the bounded indexed-table getter f_700076ce78, and returns a boolean that is true exactly when the mapped 32-bit table value is nonzero. The getter uses table base 0x700218a028, stride 0x50 and returns -1 for indices above 0xd9; direct callers use this routine as a predicate. decompiled/main/main_0105.c:43435-43448; helper decompiled/main/main_0056.c:36785-36798; caller decompiled/main/main_0123.c:12263-12301.
